newsitem.title: MEXICO: CARSO APPROVES SANBORN SHARE EXCHANGE.
newsitem.headline: CARSO APPROVES SANBORN SHARE EXCHANGE.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Carso on Wednesday said its board of directors had approved a reciprocal stock subscription between its retailing subsidiaries Grupo Sanborns and Sanborn Hermanos.
The conglomerate said in a statement that Sanborns would make a public offering of up to 149.99 million nominative series shares and up to 19.77 million L series shares, which have voting rights.
"Both series together account for 99.9999971 percent of shareholding equity in Sanborn Hermanos SA," the statement said.
"The purchase and reciprocal subscription price will be equal to the last trade in ordinary and L series shares listed by Sanborn prior to publication of the offering," the statement added.
The deal is subject to approval by Mexico's Securities and Banking Commission (CNBV).
